title: Swap Digital Nomad Visa comparison chart image on Product Offerings page

requirements.summary: Update the Digital Nomad Visa comparison chart to use the newly uploaded asset while preserving the existing centered 65% width layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to Product Offerings → Professionals → Digital Nomad Visa shows the new comparison chart image instead of the old one.
No other images in the Digital Nomad Visa section (Portugal/Spain/Malta/Hungary/Italy) are changed.
The comparison chart remains centered and constrained by the existing 65% width container without overflow on mobile or desktop.

file_operations.description: In the Digital Nomad Visa section’s comparison chart , replace the current src ("/assets/Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas.png") with the new static asset path. Keep the existing container styling (65% width, centered) unchanged, and do not modify the other country images’ src values.

requirements.summary: Add the uploaded comparison chart image to the frontend public assets at the path used by the Digital Nomad comparison chart.
acceptanceCriteria: The new image exists in the built frontend assets under `public/assets/` and loads successfully at runtime (no broken image icon / 404).

file_operations.description: Add the newly uploaded comparison chart image as a static frontend asset so it is served at runtime (and can be referenced from the ProductOffering comparison chart src).
